question: Who became the new CEO of CTS in July 2026?

hits.title: 8-K
hits.snippet: On June 25, 2026, CTS Corporation (“CTS” or the “Company”) announced that Kieran O’Sullivan, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer (“CEO”), will be stepping down effective as of July 6, 2026 (the “Effective Date”). Mr. O’Sullivan will remain on the Board of Directors of the Company (the “Board”) and has been appointed Executive Chairman, effective as of the Effective Date. ... In connection with Mr. O’Sullivan’s transition to Executive Chairman, the Board has appointed Pratik Trivedi as President and CEO of the Company effective as of the Effective Date. As a result of Mr. Trivedi’s appointment to the Board, the number of directors on the Board will increase from eight to nine.

hits.snippet: CTS Corporation has announced the promotion of Pratik Trivedi to Chief Executive Officer and President, effective July 6, 2026. Pratik’s elevation reflects a strong track record of execution, strategic leadership, and consistent results during his tenure as COO. His appointment is the result of a thoughtful succession planning process designed to position CTS for continued long-term success. With deep experience across high-growth technology companies and a global perspective shaped by leadership roles at CTS, Eaton, and Cummins, Pratik is well positioned to lead CTS into its next phase of growth. We also extend our sincere appreciation to Kieran O’Sullivan for his outstanding leadership over the past 14 years as CEO. Kieran will transition to Executive Chair of the Board of Directors, ensuring continuity and continued strategic guidance for the company. Thank you Kieran and congratulations, Pratik—looking forward to what’s ahead.#Leadership#CTS#ExecutiveLeadership#Growth

He will take over the role from Kieran O'Sullivan, who, after 14 years in the CEO position, will continue to contribute to the company as Executive Chair of the board. ... The transition in leadership at CTS Corporation marks a significant moment for the company as Pratik Trivedi steps into the role of CEO. Trivedi's experience as COO will be crucial as he leads the company into its next phase of growth, particularly in the rapidly evolving technology sector.
